The LA Clippers host the Los Angeles Lakers in the Clippers' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. The Clippers are 1-2 overall, 1-0 at home and 0-2 on the road, sitting 9th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back, while the Lakers are 3-0, first in the Pacific and 3rd in the West, on a three-game win streak. The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles on October 23, 2026, and the two teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.

Unavailable for the Clippers are Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (out, quadriceps soreness) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery). Unavailable for the Lakers are Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (out, oblique strain).
